import bedrock

def summarize_embedding_job_results(job_id):
    client = bedrock.client()
    response = client.get_embedding_job(job_id=job_id)
    summary = {
        'job_id': response['job_id'],
        'status': response['status'],
        'total_documents': response['total_documents'],
        'successful_documents': response['successful_documents'],
        'failed_documents': response['failed_documents'],
        'duration': response['duration']
    }
    return summary

from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer
import torch

def compute_cosine_similarity(text1, text2):
    model_name = 'sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2'
    model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(model_name)
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model_name)

    inputs1 = tokenizer(text1, return_tensors='pt', truncation=True, padding=True)
    inputs2 = tokenizer(text2, return_tensors='pt', truncation=True, padding=True)

    with torch.no_grad():
        outputs1 = model(**inputs1)
        outputs2 = model(**inputs2)

    embedding1 = outputs1.last_hidden_state.mean(dim=1).squeeze()
    embedding2 = outputs2.last_hidden_state.mean(dim=1).squeeze()

    cosine_similarity = torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(embedding1, embedding2)
    return cosine_similarity.item()

import boto3

def generate_embedding(text: str) -> dict:
    bedrock = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime')
    model_id = 'amazon.titan-embed-text-v1'
    body = {'inputText': text}
    response = bedrock.invoke_model(
        body=json.dumps(body),
        modelId=model_id,
        accept='application/json',
        contentType='application/json'
    )
    response_body = json.loads(response.get('body').read())
    return response_body

if __name__ == '__main__':
    text = 'Your text string here'
    embedding = generate_embedding(text)
    print(embedding)
